name: iterx-mcp

tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Search the IterxAI parts catalog (boards, sensors, actuators). Returns matching parts with ids for get_part.

board.description: Optional boardId to filter for compatibility.

tools.name: get_part
tools.description: Get full facts for one part by id (pins, power, libraries).

facts.description: Optional subset of facts to return.

tools.name: sync_parts_catalog
tools.description: Download (or refresh) the signed IterxAI cloud parts catalog (~10 MB, the same catalog the desktop app uses). Call it when search_parts/get_part fail with PARTS_CATALOG_SYNCING or warn PARTS_CATALOG_STALE; it may take a few minutes on a slow link. Needs a signed-in IterxAI account like every iterx tool.

refresh.description: Force a full re-download even if the cache is current.

tools.name: get_help
tools.description: iterx CLI help as data: without `command`, every command grouped with exit codes, env vars and the JSON envelope; with `command`, its usage, options, examples and notes. Use it to discover CLI-only features (flash, monitor, preview).

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Scaffold a new IterxAI hardware project (iterx.json, selection, netlist, src/main.ino, sim smoke scenario) plus agent config files. Use when the user has no project yet.

dir.description: New project directory (absolute, or relative to the server cwd).

board.description: Board id or alias, e.g. uno, esp32-devkit, esp32-s3, esp32-c3 (see get_rules topic "firmware"). Default arduino-uno.

harness.description: Comma-separated agents to configure: codex,claude,trae,workbuddy (default all).

dryRun.description: Only report the files that would be written.

tools.name: project_status
tools.description: Project summary: board, selected parts, netlist size, file health, and whether build/receipt.json is fresh or stale. Call first to orient in a project.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the IterxAI project directory (contains iterx.json). Defaults to the server cwd.

tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: Get IterxAI project authoring rules (file layout, wiring, firmware conventions). Read before editing a project.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the IterxAI project directory (contains iterx.json). Defaults to the server cwd.

tools.name: check_project
tools.description: Validate an IterxAI project (manifest, selection, netlist, firmware). Errors include a fix hint.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the IterxAI project directory (contains iterx.json). Defaults to the server cwd.

tools.name: sync_project
tools.description: Sync derived project files (selection/netlist/firmware stubs) after edits.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the IterxAI project directory (contains iterx.json). Defaults to the server cwd.

tools.name: build_project
tools.description: Compile the project firmware and write build/receipt.json.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the IterxAI project directory (contains iterx.json). Defaults to the server cwd.

tools.name: sim_run
tools.description: Run the project in the simulator, optionally with a scenario file; assertion failures are reported as errors.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the IterxAI project directory (contains iterx.json). Defaults to the server cwd.

scenario.description: Scenario file path (sim/*.yaml|*.json), relative to the project.

tools.name: ensure_toolchain
tools.description: Install (or with check:true only report) a verified standalone toolchain: managed arduino-cli + board core + project libraries, plus IterxAI simulator components (QEMU / ESP-EMU) for ESP32 boards. Idempotent; works without the desktop app.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the IterxAI project directory (contains iterx.json). Defaults to the server cwd.

board.description: Board id (e.g. arduino-uno, esp32-devkit, esp32-c3-generic); defaults to the project board.

source.description: auto (default), arduino (compile toolchain only), iterx (simulator components only) or espressif (simulator components from Espressif's official QEMU release).

check.description: Only report what is missing; download nothing.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: One-shot environment report: node, arduino-cli, cores, simulators, network, desktop bridge, login — each problem with a fix command.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the IterxAI project directory (contains iterx.json). Defaults to the server cwd.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List connected serial devices/boards available for flashing.

tools.name: render_wiring
tools.description: Render the project wiring diagram and return it as SVG text.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the IterxAI project directory (contains iterx.json). Defaults to the server cwd.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show the IterxAI login state. iterx requires an IterxAI account: when logged out (LOGIN_REQUIRED warning) every tool except get_help/whoami/doctor fails until the user runs `iterx login` in a terminal (it opens a browser to register/sign in). Callable without login.

offline.description: Only report the local token state (no network).

instructions: IterxAI hardware toolchain. Call get_rules first, then search_parts/get_part, edit project files, check_project, build_project, sim_run. Every result carries the iterx envelope {ok,status,data,error,warnings}; on error follow error.fix. iterx requires a signed-in IterxAI account: if a tool returns LOGIN_REQUIRED, ask the user to run `iterx login` in a terminal (it opens a browser to register/sign in), then retry; get_help, whoami and doctor work while logged out. iterx is a tool for AI agents: it has no AI features of its own, never calls an LLM and uses no AI quota.
